title: All About a Bright Bug
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about butterflies (the words "butterfly" and "caterpillar" are not yet decodable at this stage).

pages.brief: Ned the duckling noticing a bright orange and black butterfly resting on a cabbage leaf in the vegetable patch.
A close-up of the butterfly, its two large patterned wings spread wide.
Several butterflies of different bright colours fluttering among the vegetable plants.
The butterfly perched on a flower, its long thin tube reaching into the petals.
The butterfly fluttering down and landing gently on a leaf, wings settling flat.
The butterfly flying from one plant to another over the vegetable patch, wings open.
The butterfly resting in warm sunshine on a leaf, wings spread wide open to soak up the sun.
Ned the duckling leaning in close, examining the patterned wings of the butterfly.
The butterfly taking off from the cabbage leaf, wings beating upward.
Ned the duckling watching the butterfly flutter away over the rows of vegetables.
